body: BUG-1207 round 3 shelve is infra, not a finding: attempt 1's stale-base auto-rebase was refused by the force-push guard (origin/bug-1207 carries 88cf4ac918 — your round-2 rework fixup — not in the pr-1916 ref) and left .aida/worktrees/pr-rebase-1916 with branch pr-1916 checked out; attempt 2's reviewer then could not fetch pull/1916/head:pr-1916 ('refusing to fetch into branch checked out at …') and exited 1 → tool-exit. I removed the leftover worktree + the pr-1916 branch and filed BUG-1218 (high, drive): auto-rebase must clean its scratch worktree on every exit path, a refused force-push must shelve with a typed stale-base cause, and the reviewer checkout must tolerate a stale pr-N branch. Before BUG-1207 is re-reviewed, the branch needs reconciling by hand (fetch origin bug-1207, rebase, push) so the PR head contains 88cf4ac918. Drain is on BUG-1210 now; BUG-1202 remains.
